_comment: Copy to ~/.rea-plugin.json (or point REA_PLUGIN_CONFIG at it). Every key is optional; blank values are ignored. auto_engines=true (default) installs missing engines in the background on Windows, macOS and Linux; jdk=false stops the installer from downloading a JDK 21 when none is found; engines may include apktool/radare2 (or optional_engines=true with all); archive_dir holds pre-downloaded release files for offline installs; router=false turns automatic routing off, allow/deny are regexes tested against each prompt.
